display_long_description:
Step into the ultimate cleaning showdown in Clean Rush: Ultimate Cleaning Challenge — a fast-paced VR experience where speed, precision, and smart decisions make you the master of the mess.

Clean your way through dynamic obstacle-filled paths while racing against time and AI challengers. Equip the right cleaning tools, react quickly to incoming mess types, and clear every area before it overwhelms you.

This isn’t just a cleaning simulator — it’s a reflex-driven VR challenge designed for quick sessions, addictive gameplay, and satisfying progress.

🧼 Fast-Paced Cleaning Action

• Dash through messy environments
• Clean different types of dirt and obstacles
• Switch tools to handle every challenge
• Beat AI competitors and top your best score

🏆 Challenge Your Skills

• Increasing difficulty levels
• Speed-based objectives
• Smart reaction gameplay
• Arcade-style progression
